mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal economic expansion, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur less than 55% when trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment and rising payrolls indicate a strong labor market, positive for equities.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when both proxies indicate a strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 2% in expansion signals positive returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns less than 50% when trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: Rising real consumer spending boosts corporate earnings, positive for S&P 500.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur more than 35% when RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS with high CPIAUCSL may lead to negative real rates, affecting equity returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur more than 40% when trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment signals a strong economy, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur more than 30% when UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates economic strength, positive for S&P 500.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative more than 35% when GDPC1 grows.
